day_line: A raw blade on a Dog day. Sharp and loyal: good for keeping your word and clear decisions, easy to be too strict.

lines.Yang Wood: Midweek leans on you today. Make the hard call before lunch, then breathe.
lines.Yin Wood: People count on you today. Keep the promise you made on Monday.
lines.Yang Fire: A bold chance knocks today. Say yes, then sort out the details tomorrow.
lines.Yin Fire: The 12.12 sales are coming. Make a list today and stick to it.
lines.Yang Earth: Midweek gets silly in a good way. Bring the snacks and start the fun chat.
lines.Yin Earth: Your straight answer helps today. Say it kindly, in one message, not five.
lines.Yang Metal: Your loyal crew shows up today. Grab dinner with the ones who always reply.
lines.Yin Metal: Someone wants your slot today. Ask who needs it more; let it go if it's them.
lines.Yang Water: A quiet answer comes today. Walk without earphones and let it arrive.
lines.Yin Water: A steady hand helps you today. Ask the senior colleague; it saves the afternoon.
